summary: FEMUNDLØPET AS (org. no. 996 181 227) is a private limited company (AS) based in Røros, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2010-12-20. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 93.190 (Sportsaktiviteter ikke nevnt annet sted). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 6.8 m and net income was -NOK 503 683. CEO: Kristin Døhl; board chair: Steinar Munkhaugen.
